## Summary

Install an intake manifold spacer and perform a relearn procedure for tuning. [t775]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Remove the intake manifold stud located at the back of the intake manifold using a 10mm wrench.
2. [Partial] Install the spacer in place of the removed stud.

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Perform a relearn procedure after installation to ensure correct tuning. [t775]
- Expect noticeable power gains in the middle of the power band. [t775]

## Common mistakes

- Using a crescent wrench instead of a 10mm wrench on tight spaces, which can be difficult. [t775]
- Losing bolts during removal due to limited clearance with other metal components. [t775]
